title: Final Rate Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the rate of thickness increase as eta = kappa(T - T0) / (rho L z).

title: Final Time Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the time to double the thickness as t = (rho L(z2^2 - z1^2)) / (2 kappa(T - T0)).

title: Correct Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly substitute the values for z1, z2, and other constants in the final time calculation.

title: Heat Current Density
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the heat current density equation correctly from the principles of thermal conduction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the heat current density equation and the rate of thickness increase.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all factors, such as density and latent heat, are included in the final expressions.
